# third_party

Vendored overlays sit beside the lab's stock pins. Installing one leaves `requirements.txt` on its benchmark line.

| path | role |
| --- | --- |
| [`pyphi_iit4_mv/`](pyphi_iit4_mv/) | M1+M2 multivalued IIT 4.0 overlay for the stock `feature/iit-4.0` pin at `b78d0e342`. The same port is on `rogerSuperBuilderAlpha/pyphi@feat/multivalued-iit4-radix-k`. Upstream `wmayner/pyphi#147` closed 25 Oct 2026; PyPhi 2.0 on `main` at `134a8f31` covers mixed-radix `FactoredTPM` natively. |
